data.title: Algorithmic Trading & Technical Indicators
bullets: Automated stock screener that pulls historical prices with yfinance and computes the indicators quants use for trading signals.
Calculates Garman-Klass volatility, RSI, Bollinger Bands, ATR and MACD for S&P 500 stocks.

data.title: Credit Risk Modeling
bullets: End-to-end credit scoring pipeline that predicts loan defaults with Gradient Boosting.
Explains individual predictions with SHAP values and exports the trained model artifacts for reuse.

data.title: IPO Success Prediction
bullets: Predicts whether an upcoming IPO will list strongly from issue duration, price band and days to listing.
Compares Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM and logistic regression, and exports the model as a reusable predictor.

data.title: Portfolio Optimization (Modern Portfolio Theory)
bullets: Optimizes asset weights across SPY, BND, GLD, QQQ and VTI to maximize the Sharpe ratio.
Solves the constrained allocation problem with SciPy's SLSQP optimizer.

data.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction from Wikipedia Sentiment
bullets: Tests whether edit activity and sentiment on Bitcoin's Wikipedia page act as a leading signal for its price.
Merges historical BTC prices with edit-comment sentiment scores to forecast price movements.

data.title: Financial News Sentiment Analysis
bullets: NLP pipeline that scrapes Google News RSS headlines and turns them into a quantified market mood.
Scores headlines with VADER and FinBERT to relate news sentiment to stock and gold prices.

data.title: Stock Price Forecasting with LSTMs
bullets: Forecasts stock prices from historical time series with LSTM networks built in TensorFlow/Keras.
Targets the noisy, non-linear patterns that classical models like ARIMA struggle to capture.

data.title: Value at Risk via Monte Carlo Simulation
bullets: Estimates portfolio Value at Risk by Monte Carlo simulation of returns on market data from yfinance.
Reports the worst expected loss over a horizon at chosen confidence levels such as 95% and 99%.

data.title: LiveSubs — Live Subtitles & Translation
bullets: Live subtitles for any audio: a Chrome extension for browser tabs and an Electron Windows app that captures everything playing on the PC.
Speech-to-text with Whisper large-v3 plus context-aware AI translation into any language, with dual subtitles.
Cuts audio at pauses, passes earlier sentences as context, filters hallucinations and exports timestamped .srt transcripts.

data.title: VoiceCue DJ Studio
bullets: Extended the VoiceCue app with musical instrument identification across 8 families using a spectral classifier on the Web Audio API.
Added a DJ deck (hot cues, sweep filter, stem EQ kills, beat looper) and a 64-band FFT visualizer in React.
Transcript NLP with AFINN sentiment and named-entity recognition, plus cue-sheet export for Rekordbox, Traktor and Serato.

data.title: Live Face Age Range Estimator
bullets: Real-time webcam demo in Python and OpenCV that detects faces and predicts one of eight broad age ranges.
Runs a pretrained Caffe age classifier through OpenCV's DNN module, downloading the model files on first run.

data.title: Algae Stress Classifier
bullets: Classifies microalgae images as healthy or stressed from resized pixels, colour histograms and texture statistics extracted with OpenCV.
Benchmarks Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, SVM and logistic regression against a CNN, tuned with grid search and stratified k-fold CV.

data.title: Algae Image Analyzer (RGB & Optical Density)
bullets: Desktop tool for algae life-cycle research: drag to select a region of a photo and get its RGB statistics and optical density.
Computes channel-specific optical density for red, green and blue, and exports results for analysis; built with Python and Tkinter.

data.title: Voice AI Sales Agent
bullets: Real-time voice sales agent built on LiveKit Agents that answers customer questions from a product catalogue.
Voice pipeline with Cartesia speech, Silero voice-activity detection and Llama 3.3 70B served through Cerebras.

data.title: IndoML — Tutor Response Classification
bullets: Classifies tutor responses from the MRBench v3 dataset, starting with a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline and error analysis.
Fine-tunes BERT (bert-base-uncased) with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.

data.title: Meesho Data Science Competition
data.context: Team entry with Anurav Satyaraj · BITS Pilani Goa
bullets: Competition entry built with teammate Anurav Satyaraj, prototyping on a representative subset of the data to manage compute.
Random Forest baseline followed by a CNN image model in TensorFlow.

data.title: Object Detection for Robotics Vision
bullets: CNN image classifier on CIFAR-10 as the vision module for a robot, built with TensorFlow/Keras.
Tracks parameters and metrics with Neptune experiment logging.
Companion simulation of a line-following, obstacle-avoiding robot.

data.title: Satellite Multispectral Land Analysis
bullets: Processes large multiband satellite GeoTIFFs window by window with rasterio and computes NDVI from red and NIR bands.
Clusters land cover with K-Means and classifies it with a Random Forest.

data.title: SMS Spam Classifier
bullets: Detects spam SMS with NLTK preprocessing (stop-word removal, Porter stemming) and TF-IDF features on an imbalanced dataset.
Compared Naive Bayes variants, SVM, KNN, decision trees, Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting and XGBoost.
Serves the trained model and vectorizer through a Streamlit web app.

data.title: CS:GO Round Winner Prediction
bullets: Predicts which team wins a Counter-Strike: GO round from in-game round snapshots.
Feature analysis and model comparison with PyCaret, logistic regression, decision trees and Random Forest.

data.title: Customer Churn Prediction
bullets: Predicts which customers will churn using logistic regression, decision trees and Random Forest in scikit-learn.

data.title: Census Income Classification
bullets: Binary classification of income bracket from census records after data cleaning and EDA.
Compares logistic regression, decision tree and Random Forest models.

data.title: Flight Price Prediction
bullets: Predicts flight booking prices with linear regression, decision tree and Random Forest regressors.
Feature selection guided by correlation analysis and statsmodels.

data.title: Movie Recommendation System
bullets: Content-based movie recommender built from the TMDB 5000 movies and credits metadata with Pandas.

data.title: Netflix Prize Recommendation Engine
bullets: Collaborative-filtering recommender on the Netflix Prize ratings data using SVD from the Surprise library.

data.title: Walmart Sales Forecasting
bullets: Forecasts Walmart sales with SARIMAX time-series models in statsmodels.

data.title: Potato Price Forecasting (India)
bullets: Models Indian potato prices from 1997–2015 with Random Forest and Gradient Boosting regressors after exploratory visualisation.
